name: quetrex
description: The Quetrex agentic build system: a stack-agnostic pipeline engine plus per-language add-on packs. Every quality/security/process guarantee is enforced by a deterministic hook reading an on-disk artifact, never by agent prose. Private marketplace — github.com/Glori-Holdings/quetrex-plugins.

plugins.name: quetrex-factory
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic engine: architect -> developer(s) -> QA -> reviewer -> security-reviewer -> git-workflow, with a right-size router, bounded self-heal loops, and hook-enforced merge gates. verify-gate blocks 'done' while typecheck/lint/build/tests are red; the security-reviewer OWASP checklist hard-blocks on any Critical.

plugins.name: quetrex-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack pack: App Router/RSC conventions (TypeScript strict, Tailwind/shadcn, TanStack Query + Zustand, Drizzle on Neon, Upstash Redis), the tsc -> eslint -> next build -> drizzle -> vitest -> playwright verify chain, Fly-primary ephemeral preview + E2E with mandatory teardown, and shadcn-add / drizzle-migrate skills. Layers on quetrex-factory.

plugins.name: quetrex-python
plugins.description: Python pack: ruff + mypy/pyright + pytest verify chain, packaging/venv-aware architect guidance, and injection/deserialization/secret security lenses. Layers on quetrex-factory.

plugins.name: quetrex-rust
plugins.description: Rust pack: cargo fmt + clippy -D warnings + build + test verify chain, ownership/lifetime-aware architect guidance, and unsafe-block/panic security lenses. Layers on quetrex-factory.

plugins.name: quetrex-swift
plugins.description: Swift pack: swiftlint + swift build + swift test verify chain, concurrency/actor-aware architect guidance, and Keychain/URLSession/ATS security lenses. Layers on quetrex-factory.
